description:
# All That You Need to Know About GOA BUILDATHON ’27

Welcome to **GOA BUILDATHON ’27!**

> Where ambition meets execution.

Every great innovation starts with an idea. What makes it great is the courage to build it, the curiosity to experiment, and the determination to bring it to life.

**GOA BUILDATHON ’27** is a **36-hour, student-run hackathon** where aspiring technologists, creative thinkers, and problem-solvers come together to turn bold ideas into tangible products.

It’s a space to push boundaries, collaborate with like-minded innovators, experiment with emerging technologies, and build something that goes beyond the ordinary.

Set against the backdrop of **Goa, India**, expect an immersive build sprint filled with late-night coding, spontaneous collaborations, fresh ideas, and connections that last long after the final commit. And, of course, a little coastal magic along the way. 🌴

## What Awaits You?

- **₹10,00,000+ Prize Pool** — Compete, innovate, and get rewarded for what you build.
- **Exciting Challenges** — Tackle real-world problems and explore new possibilities.
- **36 Hours of Building** — Turn your ideas into working prototypes.
- **A Community of Innovators** — Connect with developers, designers, and ambitious builders.
- **A Platform to Showcase** — Put your creativity, technical skills, and ideas in the spotlight.

> **Don't just imagine what’s possible. Build it.**

Whether you're a first-time hacker or an experienced developer, GOA BUILDATHON ’27 is your opportunity to experiment, collaborate, and create something meaningful.

**36 HOURS. ONE GOAL. BUILD SOMETHING THAT MATTERS.**

*More details coming soon. Stay tuned!*

hackathon_faqs.answer: An independently student-organized, 36-hour hackathon planned for January 2027 in Goa, India. It brings together developers, designers and problem-solvers to collaborate and build practical solutions.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is Goa Buildathon 2027?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The event is planned for January 2027 (tentative) in Goa, India. [Exact dates and venue name] will be announced here and on our Instagram.
hackathon_faqs.question: When and where will it happen?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Anyone with a passion for building! Students, developers, designers, product thinkers, and indie hackers from all backgrounds and experience levels are welcome to participate in Goa Buildathon 2027.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Teams can consist of 2 to 4 members.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is the team size?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Goa Buildathon 2027 is 100% free for all accepted participants. There are zero entry or registration fees to apply.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there a registration fee?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Meal and refreshment arrangements are currently being planned for the 36-hour event. Resting areas are subject to venue layout. Confirmed arrangements and logistics will be shared directly with accepted participants.
hackathon_faqs.question: Will food and stay be provided?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Email goabuildathon@gmail.com or message us on Instagram @goabuildathon26.
hackathon_faqs.question: How can I contact the organisers?
